phase: Adaptive second experiment, after observing phase-one results
calibration_scope: Exactly8 known phase-one input-bank conditions; the previous phase-one fresh cases are now known calibration, not heldout.
heldout_scope: Fresh targeted seed banks, frozen before any generation/timing; known distribution families and newly larger contamination rates.
selection_policy: Original compact interval or ordinary grid when eligible; otherwise original-full-sample rank cuts S/64,S/16,S/4 as enabled. Prune widest rows until budget fits as enabled, with retained learning mass>=ceil(original S/2). First eligible model gets one actual scan; half-size actual contraction, otherwise radix. No post-scan model retry.
